content:
I have finished my online book How To Prove It with Lean. It is intended as a companion to my book How To Prove It. It explains how to use Lean to write the proofs in How To Prove It. You can find it here:
https://djvelleman.github.io/HTPIwL/
Feedback very welcome!
Looks great! And I like the typeset, too :blush: Do you use a special package to be able to show the Lean Infoview next to the Lean code or did you input this manually when you wanted to show it?
I inputed the contents of the Infoview manually. I used Quarto (https://quarto.org).
A message was moved from this topic to #general > How To Prove It with Lean by Scott Morrison.
